theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (F A : ℂ → ℂ), Even k → DifferentiableOn ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∃ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im ∧ F z ≠ 0) → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → F (z + 1) = F z) → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → F (-1 / z) = z ^ k * F z) → AnalyticAt ℂ A 0 → (∃ Y : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Y ≤ z.im → F z = A (Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * z))) → (analyticOrderNatAt A 0 : ℝ) + (analyticOrderNatAt F Complex.I : ℝ) / 2 + (analyticOrderNatAt F ((-1 + (Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ) * Complex.I) / 2) : ℝ) / 3 ≤ (k : ℝ) / 12
